items.en: According to figures shared by the German Rubber Industry Association (wdk), around 84,000 tonnes of tyres that reached the end of their useful lives in Germany last year are unaccounted for. This is 16.1 per cent of the total, and the wdk is concerned about where these waste tyres are ending up.

The Falken brand has extended its partnership with the International Handball Federation (IHF), committing to participate in both the 2027 and 2029 IHF Men’s Handball World Championships. The agreement extends a partnership that began with the 2019 World Championship and saw Falken represented at the 2023 and 2025 tournaments, giving the brand visibility on LED advertising boards and goal-area signage.
